title: This Sea Slug Steals Chloroplasts to Run on Sunlight

scenes.text: This animal steals solar panels from the plants it eats.
It's a bright green sea slug that lives in salt marshes.
It eats algae, then keeps the chloroplasts, the parts that capture sunlight.
Those stolen parts keep working inside the slug's own body.
In a well lit lab, slugs have lived for months without eating.
An animal that runs partly on sunlight.

description:
This animal steals solar panels from the plants it eats.
The sea slug Elysia chlorotica keeps chloroplasts from algae and can survive for months without food when it has light.
If you could run on sunlight, would you?
thumbnail_text: THE ANIMAL THAT RUNS ON SUNLIGHT
first_comment: Half animal, half plant. Would you trade lunch for a tan?
